question: Can native source-language Q-P-Q associations be qualified without selecting a locale based on observed source contents, by using any valid exact first-party language tag as a deterministic, unaltered text witness?
prior_failures: F29 Q42 75 locale keys but none of F29 logged their names
F30 8-locale fallback still no usable source seed label
license: Wikidata original structured item/property data, CC0. No Wikipedia article text.
label_selection: First exact valid source labels.en if safe; otherwise lexicographically smallest valid BCP-47-like lowercase language tag with a first-party label whose language field exactly equals the key and whose string passes safe_label. Preserve original label and exact source language. Never synthesize or translate.
endpoint_selection: F30 source-only deterministic Q42 P31 Q5 then Q5 P279 candidate objects, then all other observed allowed QID targets in increasing numeric QID; 24 maximum.
revision_custody: Original two seed entities have exact revision-addressed second read and identical source entity SHA256; object and property labels have one first-party read and raw-response SHA256, entity ID and revision receipt.
eligibility: At least one unqualified nondeprecated first-party witnessed item Q-P-Q triple with safe first-party labels and exact language tags. Full source snapshot separately sealed in GitHub Actions artifact; no user-library output.
metric: Count independent admitted typed relations and real composable 2-hop queries; source-free canonical numeric 12-byte/triple store equal to exact same-information symbolic set and stable cold restore, not proof of neural learning.
negatives: Wrong subject statement, qualifiers, deprecated rank, missing language, mismatched language key, source revision change, tampered source ID and malformed numeric snapshot must be excluded or fail closed.
stop: One bounded original-source attempt only. If blocked or zero admitted associations, retain FAIL/BLOCKED without changing this cohort or limits; abandon live Wikidata source for a separate verified immutable CC0 archive route.
scientific_claim: Not SCIENTIFIC_PASS, AGI, causal learning, unfamiliar transfer, trained native weight improvement or donor activation semantics.
